caption: The drawing features a single wooden chair positioned centrally against a plain, lightly textured off-white background. The chair is depicted in a realistic style with noticeable details, including a slightly uneven, hand-crafted appearance. It has two armrests that curve outward and three horizontal slats forming the backrest. The legs and rungs of the chair are rounded and connected with crossbars, providing structural support. The wood is shown in natural brown tones, with shading and grain patterns visible. There is a small label-like text in the lower right area of the drawing that reads “Shaker Chair.” No other objects or colors are present in the composition.
title: High Armchair
